topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I was sipping my morning coffee on the porch when I noticed my neighbor, Tom, walking up the driveway with a casual wave. He’s a friendly guy, always waving, but today seemed a bit different. He starts talking about how much he loves the sunny corner of my yard, how perfect it would be for a little patch of tomatoes and herbs. He’s got these plans all mapped out, even hands me a sketch. I blink a few times, looking at the intricate lines and labels. It’s a nice offer, I suppose, and he seems genuinely excited. I find myself nodding, wondering how this conversation took such an unexpected turn.
